examples.text: The companies I found at the trade fair were very varied. Not only did I find high-technology companies, but also shoemakers, advertisement companies and plane manufacturers to name but a few. (United Kingdom; C1 EFFECTIVE OPERATIONAL PROFICIENCY; 2003; Dutch; Pass)
